[valkey-glide](https://crates.io/crates/valkey-glide) is a native Rust client that's built on the same Rust engine that powers the other GLIDE clients. It includes async and blocking clients for standalone and cluster mode, pipelines and transactions, pub/sub, AWS IAM authentication, and OpenTelemetry. The command API mirrors [redis-rs 1.7.0](https://docs.rs/crate/redis/1.7.0), so most code migrates with minimal changes.

## PrismOS-AI v0.7.0

Desktop AI that runs on your laptop. Drop a file, ask a question, it remembers. Nothing leaves the machine.

### New in this release

- **Scene Builder**: one line becomes a real-time 3D scene file that works with Wi-Fi off, for example `/scene a voxel lighthouse on a rocky island in a storm at night`.
- **Security lane**: investigate logs offline (indicators, timeline, MITRE ATT&CK) and harden configs with exact fixes.
- **App Builder**: web design notes and secure-by-default
